summary: Development found a character-tag decoding error, absent target symbol-index constants, and fixture omissions in plist rooting and native symbol isolation. Each is corrected in the final run. No production runtime service was rewritten.
notes: The first plist-root failure log was overwritten during harness development; its exact omission is re-executed and retained as unrooted-symbol-plist in the final focused controls, not represented as the original log.
r7 also revealed that PUT and SYMBOL-PLIST shared a native test symbol across rows while target rows reset. The final cases use separate symbols.

An early native wrapper quoting error occurred before starting a build. The successful qualification reuses the full native test execution only after rebuilding and matching every native FASL and the native snapshot.
